Players Committee card image of [[We'll Take The Long Way (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “If We Have A Plan on table, deploy on table. Imperials deploy +1 to Theed Palace Throne Room and, while you occupy that site, you may ignore your Objective's location deployment restrictions. Once per game, may take an [Episode I] system and/or a [Theed Palace] leader into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/welltakethelongway.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 ca1ccff] (3 October 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
